title: L² Hodge theory and the LLV algebra of singular K3 moduli spaces
label: Stability and Geometric Degeneration · Paper 34

related.label: Quantitative local models for Hermitian–Einstein metrics
Canonical metrics on singular moduli of K3 bundles

abstract_html: We identify the Looijenga–Lunts–Verbitsky algebra on the intersection cohomology of singular moduli spaces of sheaves on K3 surfaces with the orthogonal Lie algebra of their second cohomology enlarged by a hyperbolic plane. The surfaces have Picard rank one, the Mukai vector is twice a primitive vector of square at least four, and the rank and polarisation satisfy numerical conditions ensuring that all semistable sheaves are locally free. These moduli spaces have two singular strata and admit no symplectic resolution. For their natural hyperkähler metric, we identify square integrable cohomology with intersection cohomology and prove that harmonic forms are preserved by the three Lefschetz operators and their adjoints. The analytic argument extends the Kähler cone theorem to singular links and establishes invariance of operator domains under metric comparisons that distinguish tangential and normal directions at the strata. Monodromy then extends the relations supplied by one positive three-plane to the full second cohomology. We also determine the subrepresentation generated by the unit and, under an explicit Hodge-theoretic comparison hypothesis, the complete representation in dimension eighteen.
